summary: Agree Realty Corporation disclosed that its operating subsidiary, Agree Limited Partnership, completed an underwritten public offering of $400 million aggregate principal amount of 5.650% senior unsecured notes due 2036, fully and unconditionally guaranteed by the parent and certain subsidiary guarantors. The notes priced at 97.847% of par under an underwriting agreement, with U.S. Bank Trust Company as trustee. Proceeds are unlabeled, but the covenant package limits additional indebtedness and requires maintenance of an unencumbered asset pool. The filing is a routine debt financing, not a special situation; watch credit spreads, leverage metrics, and unencumbered asset coverage.
